sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_position" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "ayah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_set" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "seed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cards_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "generator_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "phase" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("phase" IN ('morning', 'day', 'evening', 'night')), PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_event" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('intro', 'ayah', 'word', 'quiz', 'hadith', 'dua', 'name', 'reflection', 'event', 'done', 'khatm')), "context" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("context" IN ('feed', 'gate', 'reader', 'quiz', 'saved', 'review')), "action" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("action" IN ('seen', 'answered', 'saved', 'unsaved', 'skipped', 'shared', 'audio_played', 'source_opened', 'tafsir_opened', 'word_opened', 'reported')), "pos" INTEGER NULL, "value" INTEGER NULL, "correct" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("correct" IN (0, 1)), "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ayah_read" ("ayah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_read_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "read_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("ayah_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "khatm_log" ("n" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("n"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quest_log" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("slot" IN ('read', 'learn', 'act')), "quest_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK("status" IN ('open', 'done', 'skipped')), "done_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date", "slot"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "srs_item" ("lemma_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("state" IN ('new', 'learning', 'review', 'relearning')), "ease_factor" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5, "interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "due" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_review" INTEGER NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('word_card', 'manual')), "stability" REAL NULL, "difficulty" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lemma_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "srs_review" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "lemma_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grade" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elapsed_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scheduled_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state_before" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("state_before" IN ('new', 'learning', 'review', 'relearning')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_log" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "prayer" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("prayer" IN ('fajr', 'dhuhr', 'asr', 'maghrib', 'isha')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('on_time', 'late', 'missed', 'qada', 'excused')), "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date", "prayer"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fast_log" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('ramadan', 'sunnah', 'qada', 'nafl')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_log" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('done', 'grace', 'missed', 'excused')), "sources" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streak_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "longest" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "grace_left" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "grace_refill_at" TEXT NULL, "last_evaluated_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "blocked_app" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "platform_ref" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "label" TEXT NULL, "cards_required" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "unlock_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "prayer_lock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("prayer_lock" IN (0, 1)), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gate_session" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "blocked_app_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES blocked_app (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "cards_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "result" TEXT NULL CHECK("result" IN ('passed', 'emergency', 'dismissed', 'prayer_locked', 'error')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "unlock_event" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "blocked_app_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES blocked_app (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('cards', 'emergency', 'error')), "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_card" ("card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("card_id"));
CREATE INDEX card_event_date ON card_event (date)
CREATE INDEX card_event_card_id ON card_event (card_id)
CREATE INDEX card_event_type_action ON card_event (type, "action", card_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX card_event_seen_unique ON card_event (date, card_id, context) WHERE "action" = 'seen'
CREATE INDEX srs_item_due ON srs_item (due)
CREATE INDEX srs_review_lemma ON srs_review (lemma_id)
CREATE INDEX unlock_event_ts ON unlock_event (ts)
CREATE INDEX saved_card_saved_at ON saved_card (saved_at)
